extraction.notes: BRT reports no adjusted/core FFO metric; AFFO is built directly from NAREIT FFO. The share count used for FFO/AFFO per share is not printed in the pages provided. I used the GAAP weighted average basic and diluted count, 18,063,713 shares, converted to thousands. It gives about 0.35 for FFO and 0.41 for AFFO, not the reported 0.33 and 0.39. Period-end shares outstanding of 18,882 thousand (page seq 6) give 0.33 and 0.39, so the per-share denominator probably includes unvested restricted stock. The AFFO NCI adjustment is printed as "—", so it is recorded as 0. Blank rows in the source were skipped. The subtotals foot to the printed totals.
